SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(od.company_id, o.company_id)) FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN sys_business b ON b.id = od.business_id WHERE b.business_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() AND o.create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_type != 'REFUND'
AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE od.order_detail_type = 'RENEW' AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() AND o.create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_type != 'REFUND'
AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
